learning_outcomes.description: Explain process life cycles, context switching, and multithreading models.
Solve concurrency and synchronization challenges using semaphores, mutexes, and condition variables.
Evaluate virtual memory architectures, page replacement policies (LRU, FIFO, Clock), and disk scheduling.

weeks.topic: Introduction to Operating System Architectures and System Calls.
Process Management, Process Control Blocks (PCB), and IPC.
Threads, Concurrency, and Multithreaded Programming Models.
CPU Scheduling Algorithms (FCFS, SJF, Round Robin, Multi-level Queues).
Synchronization Primitives, Critical Section Problem, and Deadlocks.
Main Memory Organization, Address Translation, and Segmentation.
Virtual Memory, Demand Paging, and Page Replacement Algorithms.
Mass Storage Systems, RAID Levels, and Disk Scheduling.
File System Interface, Directory Implementation, and File Allocation.
